EmailTemplate.subject: Are you attending the HFMA Western Symposium conference this month?
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {{lead.First Name:default=}},
Are you attending the HFMA Western Symposium this month?
Our team would like to invite you to join Flywire and Elevate at Alexxa's in the Paris Hotel on Sunday, January 22nd from 6:00pm - 8:00pm for a happy hour reception and an evening of networking and reconnecting!
If you would like to attend the event, please RSVP here. <[[https://elevatepfs.com/hfma-wrs/?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>
If you’re interested in setting up some time to discuss how we've empowered our clients to help their patients' mitigate the healthcare affordability crisis while reducing their staffing issues, please schedule some time here. <[[https://meet.yesware.com/me/brent-hansen/30min?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>
Let me know and we’ll connect soon.
Thanks,
Brent
Brent Hansen Sales Director, Healthcare
